title: Patrol
description: data of: patrol.py PROGRAMME [--plan | --dry-run] --json, or patrol.py --analyse SESSION --json, or patrol.py --sweep [--all-history] --json. A discovery patrol of one field: whether it is ready, the commands it runs to point and image, and after the night the depth, the subtraction, the vetting and a short answer. Also kept as patrol.json in the session.

summary.description: The answer, a line at a time.

pictures.description: For each unexplained candidate: the night, the reference and the difference.

alerted.description: The candidate book's IDs the person was told of (notify.py), each with its report packet made.

stops.description: Whether it keeps the patrol from moving anything.

fields.description: Each field imaged: its analysis, and with an unexplained candidate, a second look (more frames at once, searched the same way).

sweep.description: --sweep: how far back it looked, "3 days" or "all".

searched.description: --sweep: each session searched, with its short answer.
